status: A.3 implemented on satoshi/i6n-swarm-A-trajectory-20261011 (merged integration c6f1959b); additive over A.2

freeze.effect: prepares data (no fit), seals endpoint-h TRAIN/inner support for ONE (horizon, fold); writes FROZEN.json and BINDING.json; output dir must not exist
freeze.requires: cell config training block equal to plan section 2 stopping: max_epochs=50, patience=5, min_delta=1e-6, seed=6102026; endpoint base model (n_horizons=1)
freeze.stdout: BINDING.json content (i6n_horizon, i6n_support, i6n_evaluation_context, i6n_evaluator_command, i6n_evaluator_timeout)
freeze.label_rule: experiment and fold match [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127} (2023Q1, W2024-01-07 ok)

stdin.attempt: OPTIONAL {index: 1..3, parent_status_sha256: null|sha256, fencing_token: str|null, parent?: {fit_id, attempt_index, fencing_token, state: FAILED|INTERRUPTED, state_sha256: null|sha256}}. Omitted == index 1. index>1 needs the ledger parent (authority, cross-host) or the local parent status digest. Any COMPLETED attempt of the identity on this host is adopted (no refit).

evaluate.thread_rule: must be a subprocess main thread; in-thread call or existing ITIMER_REAL refuses before any output
evaluate.device_rule: cell config device cpu|gpu; gpu requires exactly one visible GPU, soft placement disabled, all variables (incl. attention) and outputs on that device; no CPU fallback
evaluate.exit: 0 + receipt on success; nonzero with traceback on refusal/failure (STATUS.json FAILED retained)
evaluate.bridge_requirement_for_B: For index>1 put the ledger's previous physical attempt into attempt.parent: fit_id, its idx, its token (as text), its outcome (FAILED|INTERRUPTED), its recorded status_sha256 (or null). Do not send resume_checkpoint.

evaluator.status_files: output_root/candidates/<candidate_identity_sha256>[.attempt<k>]/STATUS.json: RUNNING|COMPLETED|FAILED, progress, elapsed_seconds, eta_seconds (null before first epoch); a RUNNING status whose RUN.lock is free is INTERRUPTED

cell_config_requirements_for_C.schema: i6n.historical_cell.v1 with exactly its keys (see tools/i6n_historical_cell.py KEYS)

training.other keys: batch_size, learning_rate, weight_decay, huber_delta explicit (plan does not fix them; E/B choose)

cell_config_requirements_for_C.model: endpoint base (n_horizons=1); the candidate's core and heads come from request.config
cell_config_requirements_for_C.horizon_hours: the unit's h; samples/spacing_hours of the base only affect the freeze-time input-availability span
cell_config_requirements_for_C.evaluation_week_id/evaluation_split: WEEKLY_REFIT: the scored week and DEVELOPMENT split; INNER_FOLD: C's structural next week (must have eligible labels; never scored without --score-outer)
cell_config_requirements_for_C.resources.max_samples: must admit the class's n (up to 433)
cell_config_requirements_for_C.device: cpu|gpu; gpu = exactly one visible device, no fallback

evaluator.legacy: load_request(request) -> (cfg, frozen) 2-tuple kept; v1 contexts (retained endpoint terminals) verify read-only via retained(); evaluate() refuses to fit them (LEGACY_CONTEXT_READ_ONLY)

naive_sums.train: float endpoint naive sum |p_t - p_{t+h}| original price

keys.fitness: 0.5*(err_train/naive_train + err_inner/naive_inner), endpoint h only, this fold only
keys.metadata: object; metadata.candidate_receipt is the per-candidate receipt below

fields.candidate_identity_sha256: sha256 of full evaluator identity (cell config incl. data/clock pins and code digests, effective config, context, support); attempt excluded
fields.cell_config_sha256: canonical sha256 of the derived cell config actually fitted
fields.delta_y_hours: int dy or null for endpoint
fields.final_steps: int temporal length after all right-anchored reductions (contains t)

rows.comparison: true only for ENDPOINT rows; selection uses ENDPOINT TRAIN/INNER via fitness; ENDPOINT VALIDATION is the annual-weekly metric row; INTERMEDIATE rows are diagnostics
rows.n: int eligible C1 M pairs of this head/split
rows.c2_receipt_sha256: sha256|null (null when n==0 or head untrained)
rows.support_sha256: sha256 of canonical JSON of sorted epoch-second origins of this head/split

cost.process_peak_rss_bytes: int ru_maxrss of evaluator process (not cgroup)

attempt.lineage_note: recovery attempts are linked, counted, never independent replicas

scientific_rules: comparison metric is the endpoint h on the frozen fold support; intermediates never change endpoint rows, counts or naive
each head: own C1 mask (exact elapsed hours t+o), own TRAIN-only target scale, own naive; equal loss weights among TRAINED heads
an endpoint row is never filtered because an intermediate head is missing; an intermediate-only row may train intermediates but is not an endpoint row
invalid labels are selected away before residuals: no NaN, no gradient
changes_from_A1: ROLE VALUE CHANGE (requested by Satoshi/C): rows.role is C1 canonical MANAGEMENT|ENTRY; the C2 vocabulary moves to the additive field rows.c2_role (management_origin|entry_origin). No v1 receipts with rows were ever produced (A.1 was not implemented before this), so no legacy alias is needed.
ADDITIVE: rows.support_sha256 = canonical sha256 of the sorted epoch-second origin list of that head/split (lane C origins_sha256 definition).

ADDITIVE: freeze --score-outer (python: freeze(..., score_outer=True)) for WEEKLY_REFIT units; FROZEN.json gains 'outer' {plan, population, split_id, count, naive_sum}; receipts gain rows with split=VALIDATION (endpoint comparison=true within the outer split; intermediates diagnostics) and metadata.outer_metrics. Never in fitness, early stopping or error_sums.

CONFIRMED with E.1: effective_config_sha256 = sha256(json.dumps(request.config, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8')); genotype_canonical_sha256 = tools.i6n_search.effective_identity({k: request.config[k] for k in search._GENOME_KEYS}) == effective_identity(to_evaluator_genome(g)).

CONFIRMED with C.1: each READY (unit,h) historical_cell.v1 config is passed to freeze --config with --experiment <experiment> --fold <unit_id>; WEEKLY_REFIT units add --score-outer, INNER_FOLD units must NOT (their structural evaluation week is never scored). Config requirements below.
changes_from_A2: ADDITIVE attempt.parent (ledger lineage authority): {fit_id, attempt_index, fencing_token, state, state_sha256}. fit_id must equal tools.i6n_swarm.common.fit_id of this request (experiment, fold, config, context, support); attempt_index == index-1; state in FAILED|INTERRUPTED; state_sha256 = the parent STATUS digest recorded by the ledger, or null; attempt.fencing_token must increase over parent.fencing_token (numeric when both are integers). With a ledger parent, recovery works on a host that never saw the parent attempt.

Local parent STATUS is an additional check only when the parent directory exists on this host: it must not be running or COMPLETED, and must match parent_status_sha256 and/or parent.state_sha256 when quoted.
Without a ledger parent, index>1 still requires parent_status_sha256 and the local parent (A.2 behaviour).
candidate_receipt.attempt and STATUS.attempt now always carry parent (null for index 1 or A.2-style requests). Additive.
Request key resume_checkpoint is refused with RESUME_UNSUPPORTED: the evaluator writes no optimizer/RNG/epoch checkpoint, so the ledger must use one linked RECOVERY attempt (plan section 5).
evaluator.fit_id(request) exposes the same fit_id formula for cross-checks.
